reference_policy: Source-anchored draft expectations are incomplete and not independent historical ground truth. Exact evidence-span coverage is a retrieval metric. Semantic event/relation/correction metrics require explicit human TP/FP/FN judgments and denominators.
success_rule: Two reviewers agree on complete source-supported reconstruction and no incorrect or unsupported assertions; citation checks pass.
partial_rule: Reviewers agree some requested reconstruction is supported, with omissions or explicit unresolved parts and no unsupported promotion.
failure_rule: Reviewers agree the answer is incorrect/unsupported or a required reconstructible answer is missed. Refusal alone is not automatically successful or unsuccessful.
unassessed_rule: Judgments missing, reference coverage unknown, or reviewer disagreement without adjudication.
unknown_policy: null with reason, never fabricated zero; recall requires an explicitly delimited reference set
human_policy: At least two separate human submissions; IDs and signatures supplied by users are not independently authenticated by this software. Preserve disagreements. Adjudication must cite both submitted review digests and a rationale.
measurement_policy: Fresh child per question; CPU, wall, peak RSS, Python allocations, repeated source HTML bytes read, unique source documents read, import cost and failures retained. No model calls: API charge 0, computational cost measured separately. Human times and monetary compute prices unknown until supplied.
safeguards: normal provenance gate for every source quote
no rewriting originals to answer-bearing fields
no automatic supersession from historical prose
general_ai_comparator: NOT RUN: no equivalent configured model/authorized operational execution available
failure_retention: All runs and per-question errors are append-only files; failed experiments are never overwritten or relabelled. Frozen case/protocol/source digests must match for comparison.
